title: Bound and recover orphaned atomic-vector preparation files
description: ROBUSTNESS/RESOURCE SECURITY: test/vectors/atomic_json.py can leak same-directory backup/temp files created before an entry is appended and before the journal is published. In particular, if backup _prepare succeeds and the following new-content _prepare fails/crashes, the backup is not in entries and the exception cleanup cannot remove it; a process crash anywhere before journal publication similarly leaves all prepared files forever. _recover_transaction only cleans names recorded in a journal. Repeated failures can exhaust the vector filesystem. Track each artifact immediately and clean it on exceptions, and add a safe bounded orphan-recovery scheme tied to the lock/transaction identity with crash-injection tests.
